storms.name: Winter Storm Uri
storms.note: FEMA DR-4586 incident period Feb 11-21; ERCOT rotating outages Feb 15-18.

storms.name: Hurricane Nicholas
storms.note: Category 1 landfall on the Matagorda Peninsula, Sep 14.

storms.name: Winter Storm Mara (ice storm)
storms.note: Worst Central Texas icing in 15+ years, Jan 31-Feb 2; Austin restoration ran about a week.

storms.name: Houston derecho
storms.note: Evening of May 16; winds near 100 mph in downtown Houston.

storms.name: Memorial Day storms (Dallas derecho)
storms.note: Dawn of May 28 in Dallas-Fort Worth; storms also hit Houston that afternoon.

storms.name: Hurricane Beryl
storms.note: Category 1 landfall near Matagorda, 4 AM Jul 8; about 2.2M CenterPoint customers out.
